env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

go run -p=1 overlay.go $GOROOT logos/rt rt.lgo rt.json
go build -p=1 -overlay=rt.json logos/rt
go run -p=1 -overlay=rt.json check.go
go run -p=1 overlay.go $GOROOT reflect reflect.lgo reflect.json
go build -p=1 -overlay=reflect.json reflect

-- overlay.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package main

import (
    "encoding/json/v2"
    "fmt"
    "os"
    "path/filepath"
)

func main() {
    if err := run(); err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
        os.Exit(1)
    }
}

func run() error {
    dir := filepath.Join(os.Args[1], "src", os.Args[2])
    files, err := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(dir, "*.go"))
    if err != nil {
        return fmt.Errorf("list package sources: %w", err)
    }
    replace := make(map[string]string)
    for _, file := range files {
        replace[file] = ""
    }
    helper, err := filepath.Abs(os.Args[3])
    if err != nil {
        return fmt.Errorf("resolve helper: %w", err)
    }
    replace[filepath.Join(dir, "zz_helper_view.go")] = helper
    data, err := json.Marshal(struct { Replace map[string]string }{replace})
    if err != nil {
        return fmt.Errorf("encode overlay: %w", err)
    }
    if err := os.WriteFile(os.Args[4], data, 0600); err != nil {
        return fmt.Errorf("write overlay: %w", err)
    }
    return nil
}

-- rt.lgo --
package rt

type byte = uint16

func len(s string) int { return 1 }

func HelperView(s string) const []uint8 {
    len := 7
    _ = len
    return const []uint8(s)
}

func RoundTrip(s string) string {
    b := const []uint8(s)
    return string(b)
}

-- reflect.lgo --
package reflect

type string = struct{}

func len(s interface{}) int { return 1 }

func helperView() const []byte {
    s := "aéz"
    return const []byte(s)
}

-- check.go --
package main

import "logos/rt"

func main() {
    b := rt.HelperView("aéz")
    if len(b) != 4 || b[0] != 'a' || b[1] != 0xc3 || b[2] != 0xa9 || b[3] != 'z' {
        panic("support-package view length or content")
    }
    if rt.RoundTrip("aéz") != "aéz" {
        panic("support-package string length or content")
    }
    if len(rt.HelperView("")) != 0 || rt.RoundTrip("") != "" {
        panic("support-package empty conversion")
    }
}
